overview.title: Security
overview.description: Manage authentication, access restrictions and the password policy for your organization.

sso.label: Single sign-on (SSO)
sso.description: Let users sign in through your own identity provider.

twofa.label: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twofa.description: An extra verification step with an authenticator app at sign-in.

ipAllowlist.label: IP allowlist
ipAllowlist.description: Restrict access to trusted IP addresses and network ranges.

passwordPolicy.label: Password policy
passwordPolicy.description: Set requirements for passwords, the 2FA policy and session timeout.

roles.label: Roles and permissions
roles.description: Decide which roles can access which parts of the platform.

audit.label: Audit log
audit.description: Review security events and changes across your organization.

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.description: Protect your account with an extra verification step at sign-in.

policyBanner.title: 2FA is required for your account
policyBanner.deadline: Set up 2FA before {{date}}, otherwise your access will be restricted.
policyBanner.noDeadline: Set up 2FA as soon as possible to keep your access.

idle.title: Enable two-factor authentication
idle.description: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app and confirm with a code to activate 2FA.

scan.title: Step 1 · Scan the QR code
scan.noApp: No authenticator app yet? Download one:
scan.step2Label: Step 2 · Enter the 6-digit code from your app

backup.title: Save your backup codes
backup.warningTitle: Store these codes in a safe place
backup.warningBody: A backup code lets you sign in when you don't have access to your authenticator app. Each code works only once.
backup.confirmSaved: I have saved my backup codes in a safe place.

disableDialog.title: Disable two-factor authentication
disableDialog.warning: Disabling 2FA makes your account less secure. Enter your password and a code from your authenticator app or a backup code to confirm.

policy.title: Organization policy
policy.description: Enforce two-factor authentication for all users in your organization. Users without 2FA are blocked after the grace period until they set it up.
policy.requireAllHint: All users must set up 2FA to keep access.
policy.graceHint: Number of days users get to set up 2FA before access is restricted (0–90).

regenDialog.title: Regenerate backup codes
regenDialog.warning: Regenerating invalidates all your existing backup codes. Enter a code from your authenticator app to confirm.

downloadFile.footer: Keep this file in a safe place. Each code works only once.

verified.title: Code verified
verified.description: Your two-factor authentication is almost ready — now save your backup codes.

ipAllowlist.title: IP allowlist
ipAllowlist.description: Restrict access to your organization to trusted IP addresses and network ranges.

lockoutGuard.title: Heads up: your current IP is not on the list
lockoutGuard.bodyWithIp: Your current IP address ({{ip}}) falls outside all allowed ranges. If you enable the allowlist, you may lock yourself out.

toggle.title: Enable IP allowlist
toggle.description: When this is on, only requests from allowed ranges are granted access.

verify.title: Test an IP address
verify.description: Check whether a specific IP address would be granted access under the current allowlist.

confirm.remove: Are you sure you want to remove {{cidr}} from the allowlist?
confirm.lockout: Your current IP ({{ip}}) is not on the list. If you enable the allowlist, you may lock yourself out. Continue anyway?

passwordPolicy.title: Password policy
passwordPolicy.description: Set requirements for passwords, the 2FA policy and the session timeout for your organization.

requirements.title: Password requirements
requirements.rotationHint: Require users to change their password periodically.

twofa.title: Two-factor policy
twofa.graceHint: Number of days users have to set up 2FA before their access is restricted.

session.title: Session
session.timeoutHint: Users are signed out automatically after this period of inactivity.
